correctness.rationale: The proof uses the published dual characterization. A single feasible dual function gives a lower bound for every admissible weighting after normalization. The explicit candidate is then evaluated on every edge orbit, and the decisive curvature inequality is exactly the quadratic defining the claimed optimum. The bundled verifier stress-tests 600 parameter pairs and 20 direct dual minimizations.
